name: led_parameter_transfer
spice:
* Public parameter transfer and local-model scope regression
.OPTIONS TEMP=25
VSCALE scale 0 DC 1
XBASE 0 nBASE MY_LIB_LED_DS PARAMS: ISvalue=1e-20 Nvalue=2 RSvalue=5
GBASE 0 nBASE scale 0 .02
XIS10 0 nIS10 MY_LIB_LED_DS PARAMS: ISvalue=1e-19 Nvalue=2 RSvalue=5
GIS10 0 nIS10 scale 0 .02
XN3 0 nN3 MY_LIB_LED_DS PARAMS: ISvalue=1e-20 Nvalue=3 RSvalue=5
GN3 0 nN3 scale 0 .02
XRS20 0 nRS20 MY_LIB_LED_DS PARAMS: ISvalue=1e-20 Nvalue=2 RSvalue=20
GRS20 0 nRS20 scale 0 .02
.DC VSCALE .5 1 .5
.PLOT DC V(nBASE)
.PLOT DC V(nIS10)
.PLOT DC V(nN3)
.PLOT DC V(nRS20)
.END
